conversation_parts.body:
Changing your email address on a paid subscription requires contacting our support team first to cancel your current subscription and issue a prorated refund. This prevents you from being charged twice when you resubscribe with your new email.

The process involves:

1. Contact support for subscription cancellation and refund

2. Invite your new email to the workspace

3. Accept the invitation with your new email

4. Transfer full access to all presentations manually

5. Make the new email an admin

6. Remove your old account

7. Resubscribe under the new email

Important: Don't add the new email as a member yet - this would trigger the R$ 100 charge you're seeing. The prorated billing shown in your screenshot applies when invitations are accepted. You need support to handle the subscription changes first to avoid double billing.

Step 1: Go to Settings & members from the left-hand menu on the Gamma homepage.

Payment Issues: Check if your subscription is still active by going to Settings & members > Billing > Manage subscription. An inactive subscription due to payment issues will prevent premium features from activating.

What to Check:

  1. Go to Settings & members > Billing tab
  2. Click "Manage subscription" to view your current status
  3. Look for any failed payment attempts or cancellation status

conversation_parts.body:
Yes! When you share a Gamma link, viewers cannot see your speaker notes by default.

Speaker notes are private and only visible to you in Presenter View - they're not shared with viewers or collaborators unless you manually share your screen in presenter mode.

To share your Gamma:

- Click the Share button at the top right

- Choose your access level (View, Comment, or Edit)

- Copy and send the sharing link

Your notes will remain completely private to you.

conversation_parts.body:
You can save cards for later use by copying them between projects. Here's how:

Option 1 - Copy to Any Project:

1. Open the gamma containing the card you want to save

2. In the filmstrip (left sidebar), right-click the card and select Copy (or use Cmd+C/Ctrl+C)

3. Open your destination project and click in the filmstrip

4. Press Cmd+V/Ctrl+V to paste the card

Option 2 - Quick Copy (for recent projects):

1. Right-click the card in the filmstrip or use the three-dot menu

2. Choose Copy to deck

3. Select from your 5 most recently viewed gammas

The copied cards retain all formatting and content but inherit the theme of the new project. You can also select multiple cards using Shift+click to copy several at once.

conversation_parts.body:
If your Gamma site at the provided URL is showing an invalid SSL certificate error, this is often expected shortly after setting up or updating your domain. SSL certificates can take a few hours to activate after domain verification. During this period, security warnings may appear, but they should resolve automatically once the certificate is issued.

If you are using a custom domain and have configured DNS through Cloudflare, ensure your SSL/TLS setting in Cloudflare is set to "Full (Strict)" and, during verification, set the Security Level to "Medium" to help the process complete smoothly.

If the SSL error persists for more than 24 hours after setup or changes, this may indicate a deeper issue that requires further investigation. In that case, please wait the full 24 hours, then seek additional help if the problem remains .

content_sources.title: How do I create a new presentation, document, or webpage in Gamma?
What’s the easiest way to export my Gamma?

conversation_parts.body:
You can create presentations in Gamma using three different modes:

Generate - Enter a topic and our AI will create a structured draft for you. This is perfect for first drafts and brainstorming.

Paste - Copy and paste existing text (from notes, ChatGPT, or other sources) and we'll format it into a clean, professional layout.

Import - Upload an existing PowerPoint file, document, or enter a URL, and we'll import and style your content automatically.

To get started:

  1. Go to your Gamma dashboard
  2. Click Create New AI
  3. Choose your preferred mode

Once created, you can export your presentation as a PowerPoint (PPTX) file by clicking the Share button, then selecting Export.

To fix your card size gaps and make them consistent, you need to set a fixed height for all cards:

  1. Click the three-dot menu (…) in the top-right corner of your gamma
  2. Select Page Setup
  3. In the Card Size dropdown, select a fixed height option instead of the default fluid setting

This ensures all cards maintain the same dimensions and eliminates inconsistent spacing.

For your card 3 layout issue (hail damage repair), you can fix this by:

  1. Click on the affected card
  2. Look for the sparkle icon at the top left of the card
  3. Select Try new layout to browse different layout options
  4. Choose a layout that places the image beside the text rather than in a single column

You can also use Ctrl + Z (Windows) to undo recent AI changes if the layout was recently modified.

The fixed card height setting will resolve your spacing issues across the entire site, making it look more professional and consistent.

No, fixed card height won't break up content that belongs on one card. Cards automatically adjust in height to fit your content, but when you set a fixed size, it ensures all cards maintain the same dimensions while keeping your content intact.

If a card becomes too tall with the fixed height setting, the content will still stay together on that card - it just means you might need to manually move some content to a new card for better readability. The fixed height setting primarily controls spacing consistency between cards rather than forcing content to split.

Cards exist because they're the fundamental building blocks that make Gamma flexible and powerful. They serve several important purposes:

Organization & Structure: Cards act like flexible slides or sections that help organize your content into digestible chunks, making it easier for viewers to follow your story.

Dynamic Content Management: Unlike static slides, cards automatically adjust to fit your content while maintaining an organized layout. This flexibility lets you add varying amounts of content without breaking your design.

Better Readability: Cards help break up information into manageable sections. If content gets too long on one card, you can easily move some to a new card for better readability.

Versatile Layouts: Cards allow you to mix different content types - text, images, media - and apply different templates and layouts to each section as needed.

While you can merge everything into one card for your specific use case, cards give you the flexibility to create more engaging, structured content when you need it.

You can also create template pages with reusable elements like headers and footers, then duplicate them for consistency across your site.

The key difference is that websites often benefit from the structured, scannable format that cards provide, whereas presentations might use them more for storytelling flow. Your spacing issue is more about the card sizing settings than cards themselves being unsuitable for websites.

You can have unlimited pages in your Gamma website! The 2-button limit only applies to the right section of the navigation bar, not your total page count.

  • Left section: Your logo

  • Create dropdown-style "super links" that lead to pages listing related content (like a blog index page)

The sparkle icon should appear in the top-left corner of any card when you want to edit with AI. You can also access our AI editor (Agent) using keyboard shortcuts: CMD+E on Mac or CTRL+E on Windows.

If the sparkle button isn't working, try these troubleshooting steps:

• Check your internet connection - AI doesn't function without an active connection

• Wait if content is generating - AI editing is disabled while other processes are running

• Clear your browser cache and cookies - corrupted files can interfere with functionality

• Try an incognito window - browser extensions may cause compatibility issues

For Pro users, there's also a sparkle icon in the top-right that lets you edit multiple cards at once.

Hi Gamma team,

I’m Thomas from TenderRender. We already help clients write government bids and now want to also help them design and format those documents to strict specs. We’ve been experimenting with the v1.0 API and love the concept—this could let us generate compliant, on-brand documents at scale.

I have a few questions and one export issue:

Fonts & sizes in “document” format.
What’s the supported way to guarantee Arial 10/11 pt for body text (and fixed sizes for H1/H2) in document outputs? If this is theme-driven, could you share best practices for creating a minimal document theme (plain white background, no ornaments) and enforcing it via themeId?

Document templates via API.
We mainly see presentation templates in the UI. Can we create/import a document template (A4, two columns, header/footer) and call Create from Template for pixel-faithful results?

Layout control knobs.
Which parameters should we rely on for: (a) stable two-column text, (b) explicit page breaks that survive PDF export, (c) margins (e.g., 15–18 mm), and (d) forcing a plain white background regardless of theme defaults? If you have a canonical “dense A4 document” request body, we’d love to use it.

PDF export overflow (editor vs. PDF mismatch).
We’ve hit a case where the doc looks correct in the editor, but on PDF export the first page text spills off the page. Could you advise? Details below.

If possible, we’d love a 30-minute call with a salesperson or solutions engineer to validate our setup (themes vs. document templates) and ensure we can generate beautiful, compliant A4 documents via the API.

Thanks so much—excited about the potential here.

Best regards,

conversation_parts.body:
Hi Thomas! Great to hear you're exploring our API for document generation.

Document Format & Themes:

For document outputs, you can use "format": "document" with cardOptions.dimensions set to "a4" or "letter". Font control is theme-driven - create custom themes in our app with your desired Arial specifications, then reference them via themeId in your API calls.

Templates:

Currently, we support visual themes rather than structural content templates. You'll need to create themes in our app first, then reference them by ID. Content structure templates are planned for future iterations.

Layout Parameters:

Use cardOptions.dimensions: "a4" for A4 sizing and cardOptions.headerFooter for headers/footers. For specific layout control like margins and page breaks, leverage additionalInstructions to specify requirements.

PDF Export Issues:

Exports reflect Present Mode, so layout may differ from edit view. This could explain the text overflow you're experiencing.

For the detailed consultation you're requesting about themes vs. templates and A4 document generation, you'll want to speak with our solutions team who can provide specialized guidance for your government bid use case.

You can add custom HTML content to your Gamma using the slash command method. Here's how:

Using the Slash (/) Command:

  1. Click inside a text area or blank space within a card
  2. Type / to open the content search menu
  3. Browse the available options or search for HTML/embed blocks
  4. Select the desired block to insert it

Alternative Method:

You can also use the Insert Menu on the right-hand side of your screen to drag and drop embeds or other media content directly into your Gamma

The slash command provides quick keyboard access to various content blocks including embeds that support custom HTML integration.

אין לי בעיה עם צופים אנונימיים - יש לי בעיה עם העובדה שהדוח מציג 2 צופים בלבד (אחד מהם זה אני...) כאשר יש בודאות הרבה יותר. הדוח לא מתעדכן בזמן אמת?

I don't have a problem with anonymous viewers - I have a problem with the fact that the report only shows 2 viewers (one of them is me...) when there are certainly many more. The report isn't updated in real time?

––– Translated by Lokalise Messages

הדוחות באנליטיקה של גמא אינם מתעדכנים בזמן אמת. יכול להיות עיכוב בהצגת הנתונים החדשים ביותר, מה שמסביר למה אתה רואה רק 2 צופים במקום המספר הגבוה יותר שאתה מצפה לו.

כמה דברים שכדאי לבדוק:

  • וודא שיש לך הרשאות גישה מלאה למצגת
  • בדוק שאתה במנוי Pro, שנדרש לאנליטיקה מלאה
  • זכור שצופים ללא חשבון גמא או במצב גלישה פרטית יופיעו כ"Anonymous Viewer"

אם הבעיה נמשכת ויש פער משמעותי בין הצפיות הצפויות לדוח, ייתכן שיש בעיה טכנית שדורשת בדיקה נוספת.


Source:
How do I track my Gamma’s performance using analytics?

content_sources.title: How do collaboration and sharing settings work in Gamma?

conversation_parts.body:
To make all your projects viewable by anyone with the links, you'll need to update the sharing settings for each one:

  1. Open each Gamma project from your list
  2. Click the Share button at the top right of the screen
  3. Set the access level to "View" - this allows users to view but not comment or edit
  4. Copy the sharing link and distribute it

You'll need to repeat this process for all 10 projects individually.

Important note: If these projects are in a workspace where members have restricted permissions, the workspace settings may override your individual sharing settings. Check your workspace permissions if the links still don't work after updating each project's settings.

  3. Publish your site - Make sure to publish after making changes for the links to work properly

source.subject: Why Was My EDU Discount Revoked? Request for Human Review
source.body:
Hello Gamma team — I’m very disappointed to hear you cannot re-apply the teacher discount that was awarded to me last year. You promoted and granted an EDU code that led me to invest time building presentations on your platform for use with roughly 7,000 students, and it is hard to understand or accept that you now refuse to honour the same discount when a promo code field still exists at checkout. Can you explain why a code can be entered during payment but cannot be reactivated for an existing, loyal educator customer? Is it your company policy to attract educators with discounts one year and refuse to renew them the next? That practice, if intentional, is troubling and undermines trust in Gamma-AI’s treatment of existing users. Please escalate this request to someone who can confirm whether the EDU discount can be reinstated for my account or for the destination account I offered; if not, I will not renew and I will need to inform the schools and ICT partners I work with about this policy. I’m asking for a constructive, human response — not a referral to a pricing page.

Thank you,

Anthony Claeys

To add a simple border (outline) around a chart or text in Gamma, you can use the customization options available in the Theme Editor. Here’s how:

  • Open the Theme Editor.
  • Navigate to the Colors tab to adjust element outlines.
  • Look for options like Stroke and Shadow—these allow you to add outlines (borders) or hard shadows to content blocks, including charts and text.
  • After inserting your chart or text block (using the slash (/) command or the insert menu), select the block and apply your desired border style from the available customization settings.

This approach lets you visually separate or highlight content with a border effect.

To create a presentation from text with your specific requirements:

Creating from Text:

  1. Go to your Gamma dashboard and click Create New AI
  2. Choose Paste mode - this is best for formatting existing text
  3. Copy and paste your text, and Gamma will format it into cards

Language & Alignment:

  • For British English, you can specify this in the additionalInstructions when generating
  • After creation, select text and use the formatting menu to set right alignment for each card
  • Gamma's AI supports multiple languages, so you can request British English spelling during generation

Layout Structure:

While our sources show Gamma has various layout options, the specific "solid boxes only" structure isn't detailed in the available documentation. You may need to manually adjust layouts after creation or use the AI chat feature to request this specific formatting style.

Pro Tip: Use the sparkle icon to edit multiple cards at once if you have Pro access

conversation_parts.body:
The $96 charge is likely due to per-member billing - you're charged for each active user in your workspace. If you have multiple members in your workspace, your total bill multiplies by the number of users.

For example, if you have 9-10 users in your workspace, that would explain the $96 charge (around $10 per user).

To check your workspace members:

  • Go to Settings & Members from the left-hand menu
  • Review the Members tab to see all active users
  • Remove unnecessary members by selecting Remove from workspace in their Role dropdown

For the refund request, I'll need to connect you with our human support team as only they can process refunds. You may be eligible for a refund on removed members if you contact support within 7 days of their subscription start.

This conversation language is German. Create a note starting with ! to respond in a customer's language or try !help

Sie können Ihre Präsentationen von Ihrem privaten Account zu Ihrem beruflichen Account übertragen, indem Sie die Karten kopieren und einfügen.

So gehen Sie vor:

1. Melden Sie sich mit Ihrem alten privaten Account an (krings.inga@gmx.de)

2. Öffnen Sie jede Präsentation, die Sie übertragen möchten

3. Wählen Sie alle Karten aus: Drücken Sie Cmd + A (Mac) oder Strg + A (Windows) zweimal im Filmstreifen (linke Seitenleiste)

4. Kopieren Sie die Karten: Drücken Sie Cmd + C (Mac) oder Strg + C (Windows)

5. Wechseln Sie zu Ihrem beruflichen Account (i.krings@krings-ingenieure.de)

6. Erstellen Sie eine neue Präsentation oder öffnen Sie eine bestehende

7. Fügen Sie die Karten ein: Drücken Sie Cmd + V (Mac) oder Strg + V (Windows)

Die eingefügten Karten behalten ihren Inhalt und ihre Formatierung bei, übernehmen aber das Design der neuen Präsentation. Sie müssen diesen Vorgang für jede Präsentation einzeln wiederholen.

conversation_parts.body:
Hi there,

If you received an invoice for a purchase you didn't make, this could be due to a few reasons:

Most common cause: You might have multiple users in your workspace. Our billing is per-member, so if you have 2 users on a $20/month plan, you'd be charged $40 total.

To check your invoice details:

  1. Go to Settings & members from the left menu
  2. Click Billing > Manage subscription
  3. Review your invoice history in the Stripe dashboard

If this appears to be an unauthorized charge: Since you're requesting what seems to be a refund for a charge you didn't authorize, I'll need to connect you with our human support team who can investigate this billing issue and process any necessary refunds.

I can help you understand how to cancel your subscription and our refund policy.

Our refund policy allows refunds only within the first 7 days of subscribing to paid plans. Since your charge was on November 8th and it's now November 9th, you're within the 7-day window.

Your subscription will remain active until the current term ends, even after cancellation.

conversation_parts.body:
Hi Harika,

To cancel your Gamma subscription, go to the Gamma home screen, select Settings & members from the left panel, then open the Billing tab. Click Manage subscription in Stripe to access your billing portal, and select Cancel subscription. Confirm the cancellation in Stripe. Your subscription will remain active until the end of the current billing period, and no further renewals will occur after cancellation.

For a refund of your recent automatic renewal, you are eligible if you contact support within 7 days of the charge. Refunds are not issued automatically when you cancel; only a human agent can process refunds. Please wait for a human teammate to review your request and assist further.

Canceling your subscription ensures your account will not be renewed again in the future. You will retain access to your content, but premium features will be disabled after your subscription ends. Deleting your account is a separate process and is not required to stop renewals or receive a refund.

Is there anything else I can help clarify about the cancellation process while you wait for a human teammate to assist with your refund?

Hi Talal,

Let me help clarify our refund and cancellation process.

Refund Policy:

We offer refunds only within the first 7 days of subscribing to a paid plan, and refunds must be requested by contacting Customer Support - they're not automatic. Since you're requesting a refund, I'll need to connect you with a human agent who can review your specific situation and process any eligible refunds.

Subscription Cancellation:

To cancel your subscription, go to Settings & members > Billing > Cancel subscription and confirm the cancellation in Stripe. Your subscription will remain active until the current term ends.

Account vs Subscription:

Note that canceling your subscription is different from deleting your account - canceling stops future billing while keeping your account and content accessible.

Since you're requesting a refund and have billing questions about the price difference, please click "Talk to a person" to connect with a human agent who can review your account details and assist with your refund request.

Sin embargo, como tienes un plan de pago, no es posible cambiar directamente la dirección de correo electrónico de facturación sin que el sistema piense que estás añadiendo un usuario más y te cobre más. Para solucionar este problema, el servicio de asistencia de Gamma te ayudará a cancelar tu suscripción actual, emitiendo un reembolso parcial por el tiempo restante y, a continuación, añadiendo el nuevo correo electrónico como usuario al espacio de trabajo antiguo.

Si está interesado en seguir adelante, confirme lo siguiente:

¿Desea trasladarse desde una cuenta Gamma asociada a la dirección de correo electrónico rocio.dossantos.iglesias@gmail.com?

¿Desea trasladarse a la dirección de correo electrónico administracion@agenciatlc.es?

Asegúrese de que existe una cuenta Gamma creada para la dirección de correo electrónico de destino y no la añada usted mismo a su espacio de trabajo. Deberá crear una nueva cuenta gratuita de Gamma si aún no existe. Esto nos permitirá ayudarle a añadirla como nuevo usuario a su espacio de trabajo existente después de cancelar su suscripción actual.

Una vez que lo confirmes y todo te parezca bien, procederemos a cancelar cualquier suscripción de pago activa, emitiremos un reembolso prorrateado por el tiempo restante y añadiremos el nuevo correo electrónico a tu espacio de trabajo antiguo.

Ten en cuenta también que esta conversación se transferirá ahora a un agente de soporte con sede en EE.UU., por lo que si es fuera del horario laboral en EE.UU. puede haber un retraso en el procesamiento de tu solicitud después de tu confirmación.

Dae-Ho

Gamma

If you are viewing this message in the chat, I recommend copying it elsewhere for reference. Please review the following carefully:

  1. Invite your email address: Login as your old email address and go to the workspace's "Settings & members" > "Members". Invite your new email address to the workspace.
  2. Accept the invitation: Logout of Gamma then once you receive the invitation in your inbox, accept it by signing in with either your email and password or Google.
  3. Transfer access: Log back into your old account, grant full access to every Gamma presentation you created for the new user. To do this, go into each presentation, click the Share button, select Collaborate, choose Workspace member, and set the permission to Full access. This step is critical if you want your new email to have access to your previous Gamma docs.
  4. Assign admin rights: With your old account, make the new user an admin of the workspace.
  5. Remove the old user: After completing these steps, you can login as the new user and remove the old user from the workspace under the workspace's "Settings & members" > "Members" tab.
  6. Resubscribe for a new subscription: Confirm you are logged in as the new user, and the workspace members have the correct users you want to pay for. Then upgrade your account to a paid plan of your choice.

conversation_parts.body:
You're seeing two Plus subscriptions because our billing is per-member based. If you have multiple users in your workspace, each member gets charged separately at the same subscription rate.

To resolve this, check your workspace members:

  1. Go to Settings & Members from the left panel
  2. Click the Members tab to view all active members
  3. Remove any extra members by clicking their Role dropdown and selecting Remove from workspace

Important: One subscription shows "Requires confirmation" - this suggests a payment issue. The other subscription (December 7 billing) appears active and confirmed.

Since you need a refund for the duplicate charges, you'll need to speak with a human agent who can process refunds and help resolve this billing issue. Only human teammates can handle refund requests and investigate duplicate subscription scenarios.

I was charged $180 on November 8 2025 for renewal of a Gamma Pro annual plan (Invoice 19D7EFAC-0002, Visa - 9686). I did not request or authorize this renewal and received no advance notice.

Please issue a full refund of the $180 charge and confirm that my Gamma subscription has been cancelled effective immediately.

Thank you for your prompt attention.

conversation_parts.body:
Email changes aren't natively supported in our system, but there's a workaround process for paid users.

Here's what needs to happen:

First, you'll need to contact our human support team to cancel your current subscription and receive a prorated refund. This prevents you from being charged twice when you resubscribe with your new email.

The process involves these steps:

  1. Contact support for subscription cancellation and refund
  2. Invite your new email (medical.cairo@gmail.com) to your workspace via Settings & Members
  3. Accept the invitation from your new email account
  4. Transfer presentation access by sharing each gamma individually with full access to your new account
  5. Make the new email an admin of the workspace
  6. Remove your old account from the workspace
  7. Resubscribe with your new email address

Important note: You'll need access to both email addresses throughout this process, and you'll have to manually share each presentation individually - we can't transfer them automatically.

Since you're requesting subscription changes, you'll need to speak with one of our human agents who can handle the cancellation and refund process.

Payment Issues: Check if your subscription is still active by going to Settings & members > Billing > Manage subscription. An inactive subscription due to payment issues will prevent premium features from activating.

  2. Click "Manage subscription" to view your current status
  3. Look for any failed payment attempts or cancellation status
